turns.user: Is physio covered on my plan?
turns.reply: Yes. Essential Plus covers physiotherapy up to **€50 per session**, for up to **10 sessions per policy year**, with a referral from a GP or consultant required. You don’t need pre-authorisation for physiotherapy.
